messages:
samira: Putting today's 18:00 UTC release on hold after the storage proxy incident. Not safe to push. I'll coordinate reschedule. @deploy-bot please hold the pipeline and abort canary.

deploy-bot: HOLD ACK: Pipeline for release/2026-03-18T18:00 set to HOLD by samira. Canary aborted. Rolling back any partial canary pods. (run-id: ab12cd)

jess: thanks. do we have traffic on canary already? any errors in logs?

maria: some 5xx spikes during the incident window, roughly aligned with the canary roll. I'm seeing KV timeouts and increased tail latency.

leo: if canary already served traffic, i vote rollback to v1.12.3 and pin release manifest. safer than fast fix.

raph: +1 for rollback. Also propose we move the release to the Wed maintenance window (02:00 UTC) or do a hotfix if it's urgent.

samira: two options:
- rollback and reschedule to Wed 02:00 UTC (lower risk)
- attempt narrow hotfix + limited canary in 4 hours (higher risk)
Which do people prefer?

jess: rollback + Wed window. we can prepare release notes and changelog in the meantime.

maria: agree. i'll open an eval checklist and regression tests run.

samira: executing rollback now:
```
deploy rollback --service inference-api --to-tag v1.12.3 --reason "rollback after S3 proxy incident"
```

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK STARTED: inference-api -> v1.12.3 by samira. Rolling back canary and marking release/2026-03-18 as HELD. ETA 3m.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Storage proxy incident mitigated at 2026-03-18T16:54Z. Root cause under investigation.

raph: after rollback, we should pin the release manifest to v1.12.3 to prevent accidental re-deploys. I'll update the manifest and push a tag.

samira: assigned jess to update release notes and add an explicit pin. jess: can you add a line in the release notes about the hold & rollback?

jess: on it. will add: "Hold: rollback to v1.12.3 after storage proxy incident; rescheduling to Wed 02:00 UTC. See incident #642." will post PR.

leo: thumbs up. also add guidance for oncall: what to watch during the reschedule.

maria: test runs queued. CI will run full regression. ping me if you need test infra.

deploy-bot: HOLDED: release/2026-03-18 marked HELD. Next proposed window: 2026-03-19T02:00Z (Wed) — please confirm or propose alternate.

samira: confirming Wed 02:00 UTC. tagging stakeholders: @product, @support. will also update the release calendar and changelog.

jess: PR opened: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/134 — includes pinned manifest + note.

raph: OK, thanks everyone. we'll reconvene if incident status changes. :white_check_mark:

maria: ack.

samira: thanks team, closing thread. :handshake:
